correctness.rationale: For the zero-one adjacency of the once-subdivided K_n, the singular values of the unsigned incidence matrix B follow from BBᵀ=(n−2)I+J. The two nonzero singular-value modes split into opposite adjacency eigenvalues; the remaining projector is supported on the edge kernel of B and has rank n(n−3)/2, zero at n=3. Cesàro averaging pairs only equal adjacency eigenvalues, so the squared projectors are added, without mixing the opposite signs. In the edge block, writing x for intersection size, the standard edge projector has entry (x−4/n)/(n−2), and the kernel projector has entry δ−1/m−(x−4/n)/(n−2). Squaring gives the three edge orbit coefficients in the record. In the cross block, (B_ie−2/n)²=(1−4/n)B_ie+4/n² gives the stated coefficient h_n; on mean-zero modes the cross entry is h_n√(n−2). The constant block has original-vertex row sum 1/2 within that part, and the Schur sum is stochastic, giving its two stated eigenvalues. The triangular graph acts by n−4 on Bᵀ of the mean-zero space and by −2 on ker B. Substitution gives the stated b_n and η_n, and a_n b_n−(n−2)h_n²=(n−4)(n−3)/(2n(n−2)). Together the sectors exhaust n+m. The n=3 constant and standard sectors give rank 3; the n=4 standard block has only one nonzero eigenvalue per pair, giving rank 7 overall. All sectors are positive at n≥5. A separate exact characteristic-polynomial check at n=3,4,5 matched and gave ranks 3,7,15.
residual_risks: Only the proof, not the finite replay, covers all n. The Hamiltonian is specific to the unweighted adjacency; the result does not extend by this audit to other walks.

value.rationale: An established graph construction models the natural walk that alternates between vertices and incident edges, explicitly distinguished from the total-graph walk in prior work. The exact spectrum of its long-time mixing operator is informative beyond the ordinary adjacency spectrum, and the 3,7,full rank transition distinguishes the exceptional sizes from all larger complete graphs. The invariant is motivated and the closed decomposition is usable without calculating graph-sized matrices.
residual_risks: No general transport claim beyond this one-parameter family follows from the result.
